<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the molecular formula is C6H10O2 (exact mass ≈ 114.068 Da). The 13C NMR shows a carbonyl carbon at 168.6 ppm, two sp² carbons at 143.9 and 130.3 ppm (an α,β‑unsaturated system), and three aliphatic sp³ carbons at 22.8, 21.4 and 19.2 ppm (typical of allylic methyl/ methylene groups). This pattern fits an α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid such as **(E)-2‑hexenoic acid** (CH₃‑CH₂‑CH=CH‑CH₂‑COOH). The aliphatic carbons correspond to the terminal methyl (≈19 ppm), the adjacent methylene (≈21 ppm) and the allylic methylene next to the double bond (≈22.8 ppm). The double‑bond carbons appear at 143.9 ppm (C‑2) and 130.3 ppm (C‑3), and the carboxyl carbon at 168.6 ppm. This structure matches the formula, DBE = 2, and the observed carbon shifts. Therefore the SMILES string for the compound is:

**CCCC=CC(=O)O** (or equivalently **CCCC=CC(=O)O**).

<thought>We have the SMILES.</thought>
<final_answer>CCCC=CC(=O)O</final_answer>
